response.original_title: [Escalate-Guide] How to Escalate a Complaint With Freedom of the Seas Quickly
response.overview: To escalate an issue with Royal Caribbean (the operator of Freedom of the Seas), you can call their general customer service and reservations line at Royal Caribbean Support by dialing 1-(866) 254-7549. Royal Caribbean Escalation and Contact Details General Customer Service / Post-Cruise / Same-Day Sailing Help: 1-(866) 254-7549 New Reservations & Booking Modifications: 1-(866) 254-7549 (ask for the solutions team or to speak with a supervisor/manager) Corporate / Executive Relations Office: (120) 420-8151 or via email at mbayley@rccl.com (attn: Michael Bayley, though responses are not guaranteed) Onboard Emergencies (if calling from within the U.S.): (866) 254-7549(866) 254-7549-SHIP Onboard Emergencies (from outside the U.S.): (866) 254-7549 Recommended Steps to Escalate Request a Supervisor: If phone representatives via the main lines cannot resolve your issue (866) 254-7549, explicitly ask to have your case escalated to a manager or the solutions team.
response.title: [Escalate-Guide] How to Escalate a Complaint With Freedom of the Seas Quickly
